cause_prs.author: hnyls2002
cause_prs.title: [Fix] scheduler: Apply one request length policy across the scheduler, the tokenizer manager, and the Rust frontend

details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`: first seen Nov 28 01:10 (rocm10), then at 04:11 (rocm724), where its retry also failed. It passed in every earlier run back to Nov 21, except Nov 25–26, when it failed for a different reason (TileLang). The sibling class, which has a full-size pool, passed with GSM8K 0.950.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]` [#53454](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/53454) ([`29e67c32`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/29e67c3294f89067a7693dc8a4a945a72eac6e01)) made the tokenizer manager check prompt + `max_new_tokens` against `max_req_len = min(context_len, kv_capacity)` instead of `context_len`.
With `--max-total-tokens 4096` under DCP4, the pool holds 16384 tokens, so 1773 + 16000 is now rejected with a 400. Before, the scheduler clamped such requests without saying so.

The PR is in the 37-commit window [`57f3402f`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/57f3402f19944d43c6bc9d772936d2c6d6696555)..[`c17ee6f3`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/c17ee6f30b6f694fcffbcecc10bf3b37464afb3d), and the error text is in the format it introduced.
The same PR broke `test_rust_server_startup.py`, which [#53689](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/53689) fixed by raising that test's context length.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: the change looks deliberate (it also updates `test_request_length_validation.py`), so the test's `max_new_tokens=16000` may be what needs fixing.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none found (rechecked 13:20). [#51454](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/51454) and [#52026](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/52026) are related but would not fix it as written.

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: run the test at [`099d6a57`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/099d6a5792157f49e71a191dca3a57cec2f68534), the commit just before the PR, and at [`29e67c32`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/29e67c3294f89067a7693dc8a4a945a72eac6e01). Then look for other users of `UnifiedRadixTreeTestMixin` that have a small pool.
